response.evidence: Non-Hispanic White males aged 55-64 have a very high loan approval rate in the data. Out of approximately 60+ applications matching this demographic profile, only 2-3 were denied. The overall approval rate for this group exceeds 95%, which is comparable to or better than other demographic groups. The denials that did occur appear associated with unfavorable financial factors (high debt-to-income ratios >60%, loan-to-value ratios >100%, or other risk indicators) rather than demographic characteristics.
